component: OAuth object lifetime and storage notifications

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Removing an oauth:// login clears both token fields on live cached OAuth objects with the same origin and username, then removes their weak references. Realm/scope is not part of that match. Existing holders keep the cleared object; later initialization can create a new one. The two-user test checks failure/new identity for the removed user and continued reuse for the other user, then global removal. It does not establish cancellation of an in-flight token request or all same-user scope cases.
title: OAuth removal invalidates live cached objects by origin and username
